notes: Posted 25 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Insurrection, Staging Areas and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60. Three starting Effects are posted; Insurrection (listed first) is shown as the starting effect.
Posted objective 'Watch Your Step/ As You Exit the Vehicle' (wrong back-side name) dested Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough.

Posted 'Squassins' dested Squadron Assignments; 'Black-Clothed Ultra Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Chewie w/Gun' Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'Mirax's Skate' Pulsar Skate; 'Out of Comm Combo' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Mess & Proficiency' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'Coontrol/ Tunnel Vision' Control & Tunnel Vision; 'Tatooine Cel' Tatooine Celebration; 'Tatooine' and 'Cantina' the Light Premiere printings.

Posted 'Artoo & Threepio in Battle, No Destiny For You' dested Artoo, I Have A Bad Feeling About This: its game text says opponent draws no battle destiny if R2-D2 and C-3PO are in battle together, and Artoo & Threepio (also in the deck) takes cards with 'Bad Feeling' in title into hand.
'Walk Luke Walk' matches no card and is printed as written (probably a joke name for Run Luke, Run!).
The lone Location posted as 'DB' is printed as written: the strategy says the deck drains at its 2 docking bays, but the second docking bay is not named.
